entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/ad
entities.reasoning: The ad deployment pods entered CrashLoopBackOff and stopped serving, which caused downstream 5xx errors.
entities.evidence: Alert "KubePodCrashLooping" fired for ad pods; pod events show repeated ContainerCreating → CrashLoopBackOff; metrics show ad request latency > 5s and error rate > 80%.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/ad
entities.reasoning: The ad service became unavailable because all its backing pods were in CrashLoopBackOff.
entities.evidence: Service endpoint list empty in service discovery; alerts "KubeServiceUnreachable" for ad.

entities.name: otel-demo/Deployment/frontend
entities.reasoning: Frontend deployment remained running but returned 5xx responses when calling the ad service.
entities.evidence: Alert "KubePodHighHttp5xx" fired for frontend pods; trace spans show failed HTTP calls to ad service.

entities.name: otel-demo/Service/frontend
entities.reasoning: Frontend service was reachable but its backend calls failed, leading to user‑facing errors.
entities.evidence: Service endpoint healthy; alert "KubeServiceHighErrorRate" for frontend.

entities.name: otel-demo/Namespace/otel-demo
entities.reasoning: Namespace itself had no quota or limit violations; it only hosts the affected services.
entities.evidence: No namespace‑level alerts; resource usage within limits.

propagations.condition: All ad pods were in CrashLoopBackOff and not ready
propagations.effect: ad service lost all ready endpoints and became unreachable

propagations.condition: Frontend calls to ad service timed out or returned errors
propagations.effect: frontend pods generated high 5xx response rate

propagations.condition: Frontend pods returned HTTP 5xx to clients
propagations.effect: frontend service showed elevated error metrics

alerts_explained.explanation: Fired because ad pods repeatedly failed to start and entered CrashLoopBackOff.
Ad service had no ready endpoints due to its pods crashing.
Frontend pods returned many HTTP 5xx responses when downstream ad calls failed.
Frontend service error rate rose above threshold because its pods served 5xx responses.
